name: Nathan Heazlewood
story: Nathan Heazlewood was the Eagle GIS professional-services project manager for Auckland Council’s four-year Geospatial Future Mode of Operation programme. The programme consolidated inherited council GIS platforms, data and processes after Auckland’s 2010 amalgamation. A caption in Landlink, Issue 8 (May 1999), names Nathan Heazlewood as a member of the back row in a team photograph accompanying “LINZ first in mapping”. The article says the pictured team received plaques for contributions to establishing the New Zealand Topographic Digital Database and dates the four-year project to 1995 with LINZ’s predecessor DOSLI.

Parker Jones and David Pimblott belong to the earlier commercial story; later public records connect Graeme Henderson, Scott Campbell, Jithen Singh, Trevor Hart and Nathan Heazlewood with enterprise projects, technology leadership and professional services.
LINZ’s 2026 Geospatial Capability Committee material lists Nathan Heazlewood in Eagle Technology, corresponding member; Geospatial Capability Committee..
